title: Trend observation (signals.trend_observation)
description: A discovery signal stored beside the corpus: a term seen trending in a geo, with the feed's traffic label as the feed carries it and the news items it attached. One per (term, geo, first_seen); a repeat sighting moves last_seen. Buzz-class: never a quality score.

signal_class.description: Which signal feed this is, e.g. google_trends.

geo.description: The feed's geo code, e.g. US.

traffic.description: The traffic label verbatim from the feed, e.g. "2,000+"; not a number.

news_items.description: News items the feed attached to the newest sighting.
